title: se implementation scratchpad - Heritage Savings
content:
Context:
- Customer: Heritage Savings (regional bank)
- Project: Private deployment (VPC) + Dedicated capacity proof-of-concept for customer-facing chat assistant + embeddings for search/rerank.
- Primary contact: Mia Thompson (Heritage) 
- Goal: MVP in 6 weeks: private control plane, VPC peering, model pinned + canary rollout, KV prefix caching for session continuity.

Recent meetings / decisions (notes to self):
- 2026-02-12 call: agreed to start with 1x p4d-like pool (dedicated) + private control plane in us-east-1. Heritage will provide VPC CIDR and a set of test subnets.
- They require KMS integration and audit logs (S3 retention 365 days). Need compliance checklist item.
- Agreed quantization profile: int8 on transformer base, keep full fp16 for rerank model.

High-level implementation TODO (ordered):
[ ] Collect VPC details from Heritage (CIDR, subnets, account IDs) - Owner: Mia / Heritage (target 2026-02-25) - jira: HERT-560
[ ] Create infra template for VPC peering + route tables (copy from se-templates PR#78) - Owner: Jordan (due 2026-02-22)
[ ] Setup private control plane stub + KMS test keys - Owner: Ava (due 2026-02-26)
[ ] Provision dedicated pool (1 node) with pinned model redwood-llm-v2-small and rerank-v1 - Owner: Liam (due 2026-03-01)
[ ] Run load test w/ session stickiness and KV cache enabled - Owner: Jordan (due 2026-03-05)
[ ] Canary rollout (10% traffic -> 50%) and regression checks on eval set - Owner: Priya (due 2026-03-08)

Config notes / snippets (copy into infra ticket):
- Model pins: redwood/redwood-llm-v2-small@2026-02-01, redwood/rerank-v1@2026-01-10
- Batching: target_latency_ms: 120, max_batch_size: 64, prefer_latency: true for chat route
- KV cache: enable_prefix_cache: true, cache_ttl_secs: 3600, estimated memory per session ~ 80KB
- Quantization profile: seq_len <= 2048 -> int8-quantize weights (except rerank), fallback fp16 if performance regressions >2% r/o
- Autoscaling: min_replicas: 1, max_replicas: 4, scale_metric: token_throughput, buffer: 15%

Testing / validation checklist:
- Session continuity: verify context preserved after 20s idle (KV hit rate > 90%)
- Latency: p95 <= 250ms for chat baseline small model in us-east-1 under 50 rps
- Cost estimate: ~ $X/day (placeholder) - fill after infra pricing calc
- Security: KMS CMK rotation enabled, private endpoints only, no public egress for inference nodes

Open questions / blockers (notes to follow up):
- Heritage legal asked about data residency for embeddings. Confirm whether they need embeddings stored in their S3 only (we can configure object store).
- Do they want conversation logs forwarded to SIEM? If yes, map to logging pipeline and retention.
- Need exact subnet IDs for peering; ask Mia for test subnet with 2 available IPs for NAT and control plane.

Quick reminders / personal notes:
- Keep PR for infra changes small and annotated (link to se-templates PR#78).
- Schedule 30m runbook walkthrough with SRE after we provision nodes.
- Add an automated eval that checks rerank quality drop after quantization change (create eval set from heritage sample prompts).

Next immediate steps (today):
- Email Mia a short checklist of VPC fields + example answers (CIDR, subnets, route table, peering account id).
- Raise infra branch from se-templates and swap in heritage CIDR placeholders.
- Ping Priya for canary metrics dashboard template.

History / versions:
- 2025-11-12: initial notes (early discovery)
- 2026-01-18: added quantization recommendation after lab benchmarking
- 2026-02-12: sync with customer; finalized dedicated + private plan
- 2026-02-20: updated timeline and action owners

[end of scratchpad]
